title: Employee / HR / Job Tracking System
brief: Full employee time tracking, HR management, multi-job clock-in/out with pause/resume, RBAC with clearance levels, cost analysis, learning academy integration, lean/kaizen/six sigma dashboards. 60-agent scrutinized across 3 rounds (420+ findings). Reopened as the rollout envelope for the first real JM Die employee database and shop-floor system-of-record.
notes: EMP-MS0 remains the baseline architecture and scrutiny envelope, but as of 2026-04-10 it is reopened for the first real company rollout. JM Die is the canonical PRISM development and test shop, so employee/auth/clocking work is not considered finished until the system is seeded with JM Die departments, employees, clearance mappings, machine certifications, and shift rules and those records drive the app-wide system-of-record surfaces.

canonical_company_profile.name: JM Die
canonical_company_profile.role: Primary employee and shop-floor system-of-record seed profile

jm_die_rollout_focus: Seed departments, employees, badge/login identity, clearance levels, and supervisor relationships for JM Die.
Bind machine certifications and role gates to the canonical JM Die machine packages published through MCAT-MS0.
Route shop-floor clocking, HR, and employee/mobile continuity through the JM Die-backed system of record instead of generic fixture assumptions.
Treat prior scrutiny as baseline hardening, not as proof that the JM Die company rollout is complete.

phases.title: Security + Backend Wiring
phases.description: Fix critical security vulnerabilities (zero auth on ERP routes), add missing dispatcher actions, wire persistence for EmployeeEngine/PayrollEngine, enhance data models with clearance levels and job tracking fields, create DB migrations.

units.title: Add auth middleware to ALL ERP routes + ownership check + timestamp validation

steps.instruction: Import verifyToken and requireRole from middleware/auth.ts into routes/erp.ts
Add verifyToken to all 50+ POST/GET routes in erp.ts
Add requireRole('hr_manager') to payroll/employee-create/invoice routes
Add ownership check: operator can only clock self (unless hr_manager+)
Add timestamp validation: reject >5 min from server time
Run npx tsc --noEmit and verify 0 errors

exit_conditions: All ERP routes require auth token

steps.instruction: Add 'job_time_pause', 'job_time_resume', 'employee_update' to z.enum in businessDispatcher.ts (line ~346)
Add case handlers calling timeClockEngine.jobPause() and jobResume()

Run npx tsc --noEmit and npx vitest run

units.title: Wire EmployeeEngine + PayrollEngine to PersistenceBridge + update ENTITY_CONFIGS

steps.instruction: Import persistenceBridge in EmployeeEngine.ts, register 'employees' Map
Add persist() calls in create(), update(), addSkill(), addCertification()
Import persistenceBridge in PayrollEngine.ts, register 'payroll_periods' and 'pay_stubs'
Update BusinessStore.ts ENTITY_CONFIGS.employees: add knownColumns for clearance_level, auth_user_id, overtime_policy + jsonColumns for overtime_policy, shift_differential
Update ENTITY_CONFIGS.job_time_entries: add knownColumns + jsonColumns for pause_periods
